summary: AAP 2.6 doesn't ship ansible-core 2.19 by default but is compatible with it as a Technology Preview; 2.19 overhauls templating and adds Data Tagging, with some breaking changes, so test playbooks in staging and see the 2.19 porting guide.
questions: What breaking changes are in ansible-core 2.19?
What is Data Tagging in ansible-core 2.19?
Should I test playbooks before using ansible-core 2.19?

answer_card.title: ansible-core 2.19 in AAP 2.6
answer_card.answer_md:
- Not included by default (2.6 ships ansible-core 2.16) but **compatible**, as Technology Preview.
- 2.19 overhauls templating and adds **Data Tagging**, surfacing problems earlier releases missed.
- Some breaking changes: test playbooks and roles in staging and read the ansible-core 2.19 porting guide.
